name: Community sourdough
description: Simply sourdough bread made from organic or sustainable stone milled regional grains. Handcrafted, slow fermented over two days and stone baked to create deep flavours and a delicious crust. Perfect paired with soup, made into sandwiches, or as toast with breakfast.
ingredients: sustainable premium white WHEAT flour, sustainable RYE flour, sustainable SPELT flour, sustainable EMMER flour (Wholegrain Milling), filtered water, pink lake salt (Mount Zero).
allergens: May contain traces of milk, egg, soy, peanuts, sesame seeds and tree nuts.

name: Danish Rye Sourdough
shortDescription: 800gm. A bread with 100% rye is a whole-grain bread.
description: It’s much healthier than your typical wheat bread. It has fewer carbohydrates, more fibres , and generally fills your stomach nicely (per calorie eaten). The bread has a soft crust, a dense but soft crumb, a nice chew, and a slight crunch from the moist seeds.
ingredients: Organic rye flour, organic broken and whole rye grains, flax seeds,, sunflower seeds, malt, water, sourdough, sea salt. Sprinkled with rough rolled rye flakes on top.
allergens: CONTAINS SESAME SEEDS. May contain traces of milk, egg, soy, peanuts and tree nuts.

name: Large Cheesecake
